tasks.short: Answer service and charge questions or refer customers

steps.what: Clarify customers' questions and establish which published service information applies
Find applicable published services information and customer service contact details
Check the source applies, answer questions and refer account-specific disputes to customer service

tasks.design: Configure indexed topic links in {DOCS} for published service explanations and contact details. The meter reader selects the topic, checks the passage and answers; account-specific charges and uncertain matches go to customer service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Published information can be slow to locate while standing with a customer.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document search and a short topic index may remove page hunting without generating financial advice.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising a billing dispute and explaining limits without giving a misleading answer.
tasks.human_edge: The reader hears the actual concern and knows when a referral is needed.
tasks.altitude: Less page hunting during visits; no new authority over bills or account changes.

reach.task: Give a clear referral with the customer's question

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configured topic lookup can retrieve approved passages; the proposed meter-reader saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers the reader's question handling, not customer service resolution or billing administration.

In s1 the meter reader captures question topic, utility type, service area and whether the question concerns a personal account. This capture and correction time remains in s1. Unknown topics or areas use manual document lookup or referral in s3.

The service information owner publishes passage text, topic, utility type, area, effective date and contact route. Existing publication is outside this task; added index maintenance is charged to other-role upkeep. No account facts are inferred.
Test native document indexing first. The machine performs an exact topic lookup, not a judgement about the customer or tariff. Any ambiguous version is checked manually in s3.
Customer conversation and all checking remain at full time; existing search runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether the document system already has this lookup
How much visit time is spent locating published information
research_questions: Does a timed visit sample show at least 20% spent finding applicable passages without prolonging the conversation?

already_counted.description: Clarify context, check applicability and deliver or refer the answer

incremental.description: Check topic shortcuts and report stale information
Maintain the published topic and version index

approvals.approved_version: Exact checked source passage version, answer wording and referral route; any change requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives gross20, less focal upkeep6 gives net14. Range0-3 assumes most visits already use known answers or only a small share needs page hunting; it is a task-specific adoption scenario, not a confidence interval.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report meter faults, damage and access problems

steps.what: Observe problems and record the meter, location, condition and service department needed
Transfer the checked problems into the service department reporting form
Verify and submit the report, calling the department directly when problems need urgent attention

tasks.design: Use the existing field reporting system in {OTHER} to populate the service report from the reader's checked observations. The reader still determines urgency, confirms the destination and submits or calls directly; the configuration does not classify hazards.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same observations can be entered again into a separate service report.
tasks.enabler_now: A native form mapping may reuse the field record without another transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe conditions, access barriers and cases needing immediate contact.
tasks.human_edge: The reader sees the site conditions and can distinguish observation from inference.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate typing; responsibility for observation and urgent escalation remains unchanged.

reach.task: Provide a complete repair or access report

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native field forms can reuse checked observation fields; no digest case measures utility meter fault reporting.

assumptions: Boundary is fault reporting by the reader, excluding inspection travel, repair and the department's resolution work.

OTHER means the utility field reporting system. In s1 the meter reader produces meter ID, verified site location, observation time, factual description, optional photograph, chosen department and human urgency decision. Capture, selecting codes and resolving missing fields remain in s1.

The machine only copies those fields into a draft. Missing IDs, unclear descriptions, absent connectivity or unmapped departments use manual entry in s3. No machine-created safe, accessible or hazard status is assumed.
Test native form reuse before any integration. The service coordinator maintains required form fields; added mapping checks are charged as other-role upkeep.
The baseline assumes genuine duplicate entry in s2, not existing automated transfer; calls and final checking retain all their time.
unknowns: Whether observation and report forms are already a single record
Which reports require urgent telephone contact
research_questions: Can native field reuse eliminate duplicate entry while retaining complete factual reports and prompt urgent calls?

already_counted.description: Observe, structure, verify and communicate the problem

incremental.description: Check failed mappings and correct report templates
Maintain reporting field mappings and destinations

approvals.approved_version: Exact report fields, attachments, urgency and destination checked before submission; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gives gross30, less focal upkeep7 gives net23. Range0-5 assumes many observations already populate reports and phone escalations dominate remaining cases; site judgement is not reduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Leave messages to arrange access for another meter reading

steps.what: Confirm meters are inaccessible and establish the appropriate contact route and return instructions
Prepare messages with the site reference and instructions for arranging another visit
Check and leave the message through the appropriate channel without promising unconfirmed times

tasks.design: Configure a fixed access-message template in {DOCS}, using checked visit details from the field scheduling system in {OTHER}. The reader checks and leaves the message by telephone, digital channel or physical card; later customer replies and booking remain outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readers may compose the same return-access instructions repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can fill factual details without inventing availability or requiring generated prose.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a safe contact route and dealing with unusual access arrangements.
tasks.human_edge: The reader knows what actually prevented access and can avoid disclosing unnecessary details.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less message preparation; no authority to promise another worker's availability.

reach.task: Explain how a customer can arrange access
reach.learn: Booking process and permitted contact channels

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a fixed template can populate repeat access messages from checked visit details; savings depend on today's message preparation.

assumptions: Boundary ends when the reader leaves the message; travel, subsequent replies, customer availability and booking are excluded without claiming their time.

OTHER means the field scheduling system. The meter reader produces site reference, verified contact or card location, visit time, factual access issue and approved booking route in s1. All capture and contact checking remain counted there.

A service information owner supplies the approved template and booking instructions. Added upkeep is charged below. No structured address, contact preference or available slot is free: missing fields require manual preparation and confirmation in s3.
Try native template configuration first. Card printing, walking to leave it, telephone delivery and corrections remain at full time in s3.
The machine makes a draft only; it neither contacts the customer nor reserves a slot.
unknowns: Whether readers already use fully prepared cards
How many messages actually need manual composition
research_questions: Do templated messages reduce preparation without increasing wrong-contact incidents or unconfirmed appointment promises?

already_counted.description: Verify inaccessible visit details and check and deliver the final message

incremental.description: Correct template exceptions and check booking instructions
Maintain approved message and contact-route wording

approvals.approved_version: Exact final message, site reference, recipient or card location and contact route; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gives gross25, less focal upkeep7 gives net18. Range0-4 assumes most readers already use printed cards or fixed messages; physical delivery and contact verification remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report a lost or broken access key

steps.what: Report lost or broken keys with identifying details and immediate access or security concerns

tasks.design: Keep the direct incident notification through {TELEPHONY}. The meter reader identifies the key and explains what is known; replacement, lock changes and security decisions stay with the responsible custodian.
tasks.previous_blocker: The essential work is recognising and communicating an unusual incident, rather than repeated transcription.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology is needed for this short, infrequent communication.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which sites may be affected and conveying uncertainty promptly.
tasks.human_edge: The reader knows the loss or damage circumstances and can answer immediate questions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this task or its decision rights.

reach.task: Supply clear details for the key incident record
reach.learn: Key identifiers and urgent security contact routes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct notification remains appropriate for infrequent key incidents; no labour saving is demonstrated.

assumptions: Boundary is the meter reader's notification, excluding the custodian's incident management, replacement and site security actions.

The reader states key identifier if known, affected site, last known possession, loss or damage circumstances and uncertainty during s1. Capture is part of its full time; unknown identifiers trigger verbal clarification, not an assumed structured asset match.
Use the existing notification route; native incident forms may support recording but no custom automation is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep is justified because no new system, template, integration or review process is introduced.
unknowns: Existing key notification procedure and security escalation contacts
research_questions: Is there measurable duplicate reporting beyond the essential direct notification?

already_counted.description: Identify and communicate the key incident and uncertainties

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and zero upkeep gives net0. Both a brief damaged-key report and a more complex lost-key conversation retain their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate report and message preparation while retaining site observation, customer contact and escalation responsibility.
reach: Provide service coordinators with complete factual reports
Give customers clear booking and service referral routes
skills_to_grow: Checking message recipients and published information versions
role.ambitious_version: A meter reader who spends less visit time retyping facts and gives clear, accurate referrals without taking over billing or security decisions.
